atoms.asks: Which target customer segment are you building for?
atoms.accepts_summary: Names segment with exclusion or labels unknown.

atoms.asks: Give this segment an archetype name and one representative quote that captures what they care about most.
atoms.accepts_summary: Archetype label plus quote in the customer's voice.

atoms.asks: What demographic and psychographic traits define this persona (age band, income, tech comfort, risk posture)?
atoms.accepts_summary: Concrete traits or labeled unknowns.

atoms.asks: Where do they sit on the adoption lifecycle (innovator, early adopter, early majority, late majority, laggard)?
atoms.accepts_summary: Lifecycle position with evidence or hypothesis label.

atoms.asks: Run the earlyvangelist check: do they have the problem, know it, search actively, cobble a workaround, and have budget?
atoms.accepts_summary: Yes/no/unknown per ladder rung with brief evidence.

atoms.asks: How will you observe real behavior (not surveys alone) — what follow-me-home or GOOB plan fits?
atoms.accepts_summary: Concrete observation plan or unknown with blocker.

atoms.asks: Review target customer work. Pass the gate, reopen a section, or record blocking unknowns.
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass gate, reopen with conflict note, or blocking unknowns.

atoms.asks: State the top problem-space benefit in action-verb form (help/check/reduce/maximize …).
atoms.accepts_summary: Benefit as verb-led outcome; evidence kind labeled.

atoms.asks: Name a second benefit to compare, also in action-verb form.
atoms.accepts_summary: Second benefit stated or skipped with reason.

atoms.asks: For the top benefit, what deeper motivation sits underneath after one why (not a full five-whys dump)?
atoms.accepts_summary: Deeper motivation or unknown; labels inference when speculative.

atoms.asks: Estimate importance (0–100%) and current satisfaction (0–100%) for your top benefit.
atoms.accepts_summary: Two percentages with basis (fact, estimate, or unknown).

atoms.asks: Which benefit has the highest opportunity score (importance × (1 − satisfaction)) and should lead the MVP?
atoms.accepts_summary: Ranked focus benefit with opportunity rationale.

atoms.asks: Review underserved needs. Pass the gate, reopen, or record unknowns.
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass gate, reopen, or blocking unknowns.

atoms.asks: Who are the key competitors or manual workarounds (including pen-and-paper) for your Kano matrix columns?
atoms.accepts_summary: Named competitors or workaround columns.

atoms.asks: List must-have table-stakes benefits your v1 MVP must match — no delighters yet.
atoms.accepts_summary: Must-haves each marked table stakes.

atoms.asks: Where will you play offense on a performance benefit versus cede defense to competitors?
atoms.accepts_summary: Offense vector and willing cede with rationale.

atoms.asks: Will v1 include a delighter, or defer delighters to post-PMF?
atoms.accepts_summary: Delighter in/out decision with reason.

atoms.asks: Write one INVEST user story for the top MVP feature chunk (As a … I want … so that …).
atoms.accepts_summary: Story plus brief INVEST pass/fail notes.

atoms.asks: Place that feature chunk on the ROI grid (return vs effort) and say v1 versus v1.1.
atoms.accepts_summary: ROI bucket and version cut with rationale.

atoms.asks: Review MVP scope. Pass the gate, reopen, or record unknowns.
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass gate, reopen, or blocking unknowns.

atoms.asks: What is the core conceptual design metaphor (the bottom of the UX iceberg)?
atoms.accepts_summary: Metaphor named with one-sentence explanation.

atoms.asks: Sketch information architecture: primary navigation and where users land first.
atoms.accepts_summary: IA outline or unknown with blocker.

atoms.asks: What is the primary user flow you must validate (start trigger to done state)?
atoms.accepts_summary: Flow steps as actions and decisions.

atoms.asks: Which cell of the 2×2 MVP test matrix fits your learning goal and budget?
atoms.accepts_summary: Matrix quadrant plus specific test format.

atoms.asks: Draft the Ramen test: warm-up intro, one task, and Sean Ellis PMF wrap-up question.
atoms.accepts_summary: Intro line, task, and PMF question text.

atoms.asks: Review prototype and test plan. Pass the gate, reopen, or record unknowns.
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass gate, reopen, or blocking unknowns.

atoms.asks: Write your equation of the business — top metric broken into adjustable levers.
atoms.accepts_summary: Equation with named levers or unknowns.

atoms.asks: Estimate LTV and CAC (ranges OK) for your model.
atoms.accepts_summary: LTV and CAC with assumptions labeled.

atoms.asks: What does your LTV:CAC ratio imply (terminal, unstable, or healthy band)?
atoms.accepts_summary: Ratio band with one corrective action if below 3.

atoms.asks: Map AARRR for your product and pick the metric that matters most (MTMM) right now.
atoms.accepts_summary: AARRR sketch plus single MTMM with retention-first check.

atoms.asks: What one experiment will you run on the MTMM (throttle or A/B plan)?
atoms.accepts_summary: Experiment design with success threshold.

atoms.asks: Review metrics plan. Pass the gate, reopen, or record unknowns.
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass gate, reopen, or blocking unknowns.
